remarks: **** offers to be reviewed Tuesday 9/15 at 3PM***** Renovated four-bedroom, three-full-bath Cape offering over 2,000 square feet of living space on a quiet, desirable street in Stamford's sought-after Springdale neighborhood. This classic Cape has been extensively updated with modern systems and finishes while thoughtfully preserving its original architectural character. The beautifully renovated eat-in kitchen features a large granite island, new LG appliances, custom cabinetry, and expanded counter and storage space, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The flexible floor plan includes three bedrooms and two full bathrooms upstairs, plus a fourth bedroom and full bathroom on the main level-perfect for guests, a home office, an in-law arrangement, or convenient single-level living. The inviting living room features a working wood-burning fireplace and refinished hardwood floors that continue throughout the home. All three bathrooms have been tastefully renovated. The finished basement provides additional flexible living and recreation space, along with a new washer and dryer and generous storage. Recent capital improvements include a new roof, central air conditioning, driveway, landscaping, and fresh interior and exterior paint. With major updates and systems already addressed, this home is truly move-in ready. Outside, enjoy a large yard with space for relaxing, entertaining, and enjoying the outdoors.
